# AGENTS.md — 20-ai-startup

Instructions for AI coding agents working in this folder.

## Context
- Template: **Tern**, ai startup, style "arXiv research paper".
- Stack: Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS 4, TypeScript. Do not add dependencies unless the user asks.
- The design contract is in `DESIGN.md`. Read it before changing anything visual.

## Files
- `lib/content.ts` — paper copy (EN + RU), demo tokens with probabilities, results, BibTeX
- `app/page.tsx` — paper layout and the Figure component
- `app/globals.css` — tokens in Tailwind `@theme`, token underlines, booktabs
- `mathml.d.ts` — MathML element types for TSX

## How to run
- `npm install`
- `npm run dev`
- `npm run build   # static export to ./out`

## Rules
- Content changes go to the content file, not into markup or components.
- Every user-facing string exists in **en** and **ru**. English is the default; `?lang=ru` and the language button switch it.
- Colors, fonts, radii and spacing are tokens. Change tokens, not individual elements.
- Keep the signature block: Figure 1: the model's answer streams token by token, underlined by confidence; hover a token for alternatives — low confidence triggers an honest 'I don't know'.
- Keep accessibility: semantic headings, visible focus, alt text, `prefers-reduced-motion` support, body text contrast ≥ 4.5:1.
- Keep it static: no backend, no booking or payment flows.
- It must read like a paper: centered title block, justified text, numbered sections, captions under figures and above tables.
- Colour is functional only: blue links, red for low confidence.
- Tables use three rules (booktabs), no vertical lines; best values in bold.
- The demo is pre-recorded data — never call a model API from the page.
- Equations are MathML, no image or JS math library.

## Done means
- The page builds/opens without console errors.
- Both languages render with no missing strings.
- Layout works from 360 px to 1920 px wide.
